content: The management of dyslipidemia is a critical component in addressing neuropathy associated with type 2 diabetes, as abnormal lipid levels significantly contribute to the development and progression of neuropathy. Controlling lipid levels may help slow the progression of neuropathy. However, conventional lipid-lowering medications, such as statins, have not demonstrated efficacy in preventing neuropathy. Instead, engaging in regular physical activity and achieving weight loss may provide more substantial benefits in mitigating the progression of neuropathy.
